verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs or workflows is a fair question for a payments platform, but the evidence shows no scheduler, cron-style automation, or recurring workflow feature. Webhooks are event-driven callbacks, the MCP server provides natural-language API access, and the payout-settings item concerns how merchants get paid. None of these is a documented ability to schedule recurring jobs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
